ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black concentrated along the trailing edge and in discrete focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface is primarily white with a continuous black perimeter on the trailing edge. Symmetrical distribution of circular grey/black focal spots (5-15 pixels in diameter) across both lobes. Visible yellowish-brown pigmentation clusters near the center-lower portion of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle estimated between 45 and 55 degrees, showing a narrow base depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary. Serrations are irregular with sharp peaks and shallow valleys, increasing in pixel amplitude toward the distal tips of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve along the trailing edge with a symmetrical outward and upward sweep reaching a terminal point at the lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible distribution of circular, ring-like high-contrast scars (dark outlines with lighter centers) scattered across both lobes, consistent with historical barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear marks observed; specifically, multiple vertical parallel rake marks on the lower right lobe and isolated horizontal scratches on the distal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacles (stony white/grey protrusions) are physically attached to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes. Faint reddish-brown linear marks are present on the lower mid-section of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentration of dark pigmentation spots clustered specifically around the inner edge of the median notch.
